assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies at least one concrete value, item, configuration, or action outcome that constitutes the proposed solution.
The level of specificity is sufficient to implement or verify the proposal directly.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only enumerates requirements, constraints, or possible approaches without selecting a concrete solution.
The reasoning reports a solution that was already implemented or observed rather than proposing it.

new.name: IMPLEMENTS_SELECTED_SOLUTION
new.definition: The action produces an artifact that realizes a concrete solution previously selected in the reasoning.

parameters.name: solution_action
parameters.description: The action that creates or modifies the solution artifact.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that selected the concrete solution.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states a concrete selected solution before the action.
The artifact created or modified by the action contains the key values, structure, or decision from that selected solution.
The action output is the solution artifact rather than auxiliary tooling or validation.
exclusion_conditions: The action creates a script, test, or diagnostic tool instead of the selected solution artifact.
The reasoning contains only a general plan or multiple unselected options.
The action content cannot be traced to the selected solution.

new.name: CREATES_VERIFICATION_ARTIFACT
new.definition: The action creates or rewrites an artifact whose purpose is to automatically check another artifact or result against specified conditions.

parameters.name: verification_action
parameters.description: The action creating or rewriting the verification artifact.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning specifying the checks or validation procedure.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning specifies checks or validation steps to be performed.
The action writes a script, test, or equivalent programmable artifact containing those checks.
The verification artifact is distinct from the solution artifact being checked.
exclusion_conditions: The action creates the final solution artifact rather than a verification tool.
The action merely runs an already existing check without creating or rewriting the check artifact.
The reasoning only states that verification should happen without defining check content.

new.name: REPORTS_EXECUTION_FAILURE
new.definition: The observation indicates that an action or script did not complete successfully and includes diagnostic evidence of the failure.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting failed execution or diagnostic error output.

assertion_conditions: The observation has an error status or contains explicit failure output such as a traceback or failure summary.
The failure output identifies an execution problem rather than merely reporting an unsuccessful search or predicate.
exclusion_conditions: The observation reports successful completion or normal output.
The observation contains only a warning or an expected negative result.

new.name: CONFIRMS_VERIFICATION_SUCCESS
new.definition: The observation reports that a validation procedure completed successfully and that the checked conditions were satisfied.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the successful validation result.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains an explicit success statement or passing result for the validation.
The validation result covers the conditions that were being checked rather than a single incidental assertion.
exclusion_conditions: The observation merely returns data or a file listing without a validation verdict.
The observation reports partial or failed checks.

new.name: PERFORMS_INTEGRITY_CHECK
new.definition: The action inspects checksums, hashes, metadata, or file listings to verify that protected input resources remain unchanged.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action performing the integrity check.

assertion_conditions: The action computes or retrieves checksums, hashes, timestamps, or comparable integrity metadata for named resources.
The action's purpose includes confirming that input resources were not modified.
exclusion_conditions: The action merely reads or writes file contents without checking integrity metadata.
The action lists files without any integrity-verification purpose.

new.name: PROVIDES_INTEGRITY_EVIDENCE
new.definition: The observation returns checksums, hashes, timestamps, or comparable metadata about resources that can be used to assess whether they were modified.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation providing integrity-relevant metadata for resources.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains integrity-relevant metadata such as checksums, hashes, sizes, or modification timestamps for named resources.
The metadata is associated with specific resources whose integrity is being assessed.
exclusion_conditions: The observation contains only file contents, execution output, or success messages.
The observation provides a directory listing without integrity-relevant metadata.
